Manual check of D08 (F1): fortified C library calls with the macOS 15.4 SDK
=============================================================================

The 15.x SDK guards its fortified macros with
`__has_builtin(__builtin___X_chk) || defined(__GNUC__)`. EvoCC defines
`__GNUC__`, so this SDK selects the checked builtins whatever `__has_builtin`
answers. The automated tests cannot assume this SDK, so this record keeps the
check with the real headers.

Date:     2026-10-13
Host:     macOS 26.6 (25G72), arm64
SDK:      /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX15.4.sdk
          (SDKSettings.json Version 15.4)
Source:   .evidence/fortify-20261013/f.c
          SHA-256 0d93764f8bc4afed2439f2fbe8a40ae843b93daaa6b18530ede9c64f00904791
Compiler: evocc 0.1.0 (6b1e0f106159 2026-10-13), the debug build of the working
          tree with this change
Reference: Apple clang version 21.0.0 (clang-2100.1.1.101)

Before the change, both commands below stopped with four `error[W0003]:
function has no declaration` diagnostics, at the vsnprintf, snprintf, memcpy
and strcpy macro uses.

$ SDKROOT=/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX15.4.sdk \
    evocc -O0 .evidence/fortify-20261013/f.c -o f-O0 && ./f-O0
x=42!
exit status 0

$ SDKROOT=/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX15.4.sdk \
    evocc -O2 .evidence/fortify-20261013/f.c -o f-O2 && ./f-O2
x=42!
exit status 0

The calls in the assembly (`-S`) are the same at -O0 and -O2:

    _vsnprintf _snprintf _memcpy ___strcpy_chk _format _puts

`vsnprintf` writes through a parameter of unknown size, so its check is
dropped as GCC drops it. The `snprintf` and `memcpy` lengths fit their
destinations. The `strcpy` source length is not known, so the call keeps
`__strcpy_chk`. Apple clang -O2 with the same SDK calls `_vsnprintf`,
`_snprintf`, `___strcpy_chk`, `_format` and `_puts`, and expands `memcpy`
inline.
